import math

enum MethodKind
    Plurality
    Runoff
    Irv
    Coombs
    Bucklin
    Borda
    Baldwin
    Nanson
    Black
    Veto
    Condorcet
    Copeland
    Minimax
    Schulze
    RankedPairs
    Kemeny
    Approval
    Stv

enum MinimaxKind
    Winning
    Margin
    Opposition

class Method(MethodKind kind, parameter := 0, MinimaxKind score := MinimaxKind.Winning)
class Ballot(int votes, int[] ranking)
class Tallies(int[] first, int[] last, int[] borda, int[][] approval, int nonblank)
class Outcome(int[] order, string[] rows)
class Choice(int candidate, bool tie)
class Edge(int from, int to)
class Election(int number, string[] names)
    active := array(#names, fill = true)
    int[] tiebreak := []
    priority := array(#names, fill = 0)
    Ballot[] groups := []
    int[] ends := []
    total := 0
    cache := map<int, Tallies>()
    int[][] pairs := []

class Laboratory()
    number := 0
    Election | none current := none

int position_of<T>(const T[] values, T value)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == value
            return int(index)
    return -1

int[] sequence(int count)
    int[] result := []
    for: 0 <= index < count
        result = result.append(index)
    return result

int[] active_field(const Election election)
    int[] result := []
    for candidate := election.names.indices()[]
        if election.active[candidate]
            result = result.append(int(candidate))
    return result

int[] without(const int[] values, const int[] removed)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        if position_of(removed, value) < 0
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

int[] effective(const int[] ranking, const int[] field)
    int[] result := []
    for candidate := ranking[]
        if position_of(field, candidate) >= 0
            result = result.append(candidate)
    return result

int[] selected(const int[] values, const int[] indices)
    int[] result := []
    for index := indices[]
        result = result.append(values[index])
    return result

int field_id(const int[] field)
    int[] powers := []
    for candidate := field[]
        powers = powers.append(2 ^ candidate)
    return powers.sum()

int[] members(int field, int count)
    int[] result := []
    for: 0 <= candidate < count
        if field / (2 ^ candidate) % 2 == 1
            result = result.append(candidate)
    return result

string name_list(const Election election, const int[] candidates, separator := ", ")
    string[] parts := []
    for candidate := candidates[]
        parts = parts.append(election.names[candidate])
    return parts.join(separator)

string tie_text(bool tie)
    return if tie then " (tie)" else ""

string money(int value)
    fraction := string(value % 100)
    if #fraction == 1
        fraction = "0" + fraction
    return string(value / 100) + "." + fraction

string value_list(const Election election, const int[] field, const int[] values, cents := false)
    string[] parts := []
    for candidate := field[]
        value := if cents then money(values[candidate]) else string(values[candidate])
        parts = parts.append(election.names[candidate] + " " + value)
    return parts.join(", ")

int[] stable_order(const int[] original, const int[] values, bool descending)
    int[] unique_votes := []
    for candidate := original[]
        if position_of(unique_votes, values[candidate]) < 0
            unique_votes = unique_votes.append(values[candidate])
    int[] result := []
    for value := unique_votes.sorted(descending = descending)[]
        for candidate := original[]
            if values[candidate] == value
                result = result.append(candidate)
    return result

int[] ordered(const Election election, const int[] field, const int[] values, bool descending)
    return stable_order(effective(election.tiebreak, field), values, descending)

Outcome finish(const Election election, const int[] order, bool tie, const string[] rows)
    return Outcome(order, rows.append("winner: " + election.names[order[0]] + tie_text(tie)))

int | error candidate_index(const Election election, string name)
    index := position_of(election.names, name)
    if index < 0
        return error("unknown candidate " + name)
    return index

int[] | error checked_names(const Election election, const string[] names)
    int[] result := []
    for name := names[]
        candidate := try candidate_index(election, name)
        if position_of(result, candidate) >= 0
            return error("duplicate candidate " + name)
        result = result.append(candidate)
    return result

void invalidate(Election &election)
    election.cache = map<int, Tallies>()
    election.pairs = []

Tallies count_field(const Election election, const int[] field)
    zero := array(#election.names, fill = 0)
    result := Tallies(zero, zero, zero, array(#field, fill = zero), 0)
    size := int(#field)
    for group := election.groups[]
        ranking := effective(group.ranking, field)
        if #ranking > 0
            result.first[ranking[0]] += group.votes
            result.nonblank += group.votes
        if #ranking == #field
            result.last[ranking[size - 1]] += group.votes
        else
            for candidate := without(field, ranking)[]
                result.last[candidate] += group.votes
        for place := ranking.indices()[]
            candidate := ranking[place]
            result.borda[candidate] += group.votes * (size - int(place) - 1)
            for: int(place) <= depth < size
                result.approval[depth][candidate] += group.votes
    return result

Tallies tallies(Election &election, const int[] field)
    key := field_id(field)
    match election.cache.get(key)
        Tallies cached
            return cached
        none
            result := count_field(election, field)
            .election.cache.set(key, result)
            return result

int[][] pairwise(Election &election)
    if #election.pairs > 0
        return election.pairs
    count := #election.names
    int[][] result := array(count, fill = array(count, fill = 0))
    for group := election.groups[]
        positions := array(count, fill = int(count))
        for place := group.ranking.indices()[]
            positions[group.ranking[place]] = int(place)
        for first := election.names.indices()[]
            for second := election.names.indices()[]
                if positions[first] < positions[second]
                    result[first][second] += group.votes
    election.pairs = result
    return result

bool majority(const int[] field, const int[] values)
    total := selected(values, field).sum()
    return 2 * selected(values, field).max() > total

Choice look_back(const Election election, const int[] field, const int[][] history)
    choices := field
    tie := false
    for: int(#history) - 1 >= round >= 0
        minimum := selected(history[round], choices).min()
        int[] following := []
        for candidate := choices[]
            if history[round][candidate] == minimum
                following = following.append(candidate)
        choices = following
        if round == int(#history) - 1
            tie = #choices > 1
    order := effective(election.tiebreak, choices)
    return Choice(order[-1], tie)

int condorcet(Election &election, const int[] field, bool loser)
    matrix := pairwise(&election)
    for candidate := field[]
        all := true
        for other := without(field, [candidate])[]
            if (loser and matrix[candidate][other] >= matrix[other][candidate]) or (not loser and matrix[candidate][other] <= matrix[other][candidate])
                all = false
        if all
            return candidate
    return -1

Outcome elimination(Election &election, const int[] field, bool coombs, exhausted := false)
    remaining := field
    int[] removed := []
    int[][] history := []
    string[] rows := []
    while true
        scores := tallies(&election, remaining)
        round := int(#rows) + 1
        string row
        if exhausted
            active := selected(scores.first, remaining).sum()
            row = "round {round}: active {active}, exhausted {election.total - active}"
        else
            row = "round {round}: " + value_list(election, remaining, scores.first)
        if #remaining == 1 or majority(remaining, scores.first)
            order := ordered(election, remaining, scores.first, true)
            for: int(#removed) - 1 >= index >= 0
                order = order.append(removed[index])
            rows = rows.append(row)
            return if exhausted then Outcome(order, rows) else finish(election, order, false, rows)
        Choice choice
        if coombs
            maximum := selected(scores.last, remaining).max()
            int[] choices := []
            for candidate := remaining[]
                if scores.last[candidate] == maximum
                    choices = choices.append(candidate)
            order := ordered(election, choices, scores.first, true)
            choice = Choice(order[-1], #choices > 1)
            row = row + "; last " + value_list(election, remaining, scores.last)
        else
            history = history.append(scores.first)
            choice = look_back(election, remaining, history)
        if not exhausted
            row = row + "; eliminated " + election.names[choice.candidate] + tie_text(choice.tie)
        rows = rows.append(row)
        removed = removed.append(choice.candidate)
        remaining = without(remaining, [choice.candidate])

Outcome runoff(Election &election, const int[] field)
    first := tallies(&election, field)
    order := ordered(election, field, first.first, true)
    rows := ["round 1: " + value_list(election, field, first.first)]
    tie := false
    if not majority(field, first.first)
        first_candidate := order[0]
        second_candidate := order[1]
        finalists := [first_candidate, second_candidate].sorted()
        advance := #order >= 3 and first.first[order[1]] == first.first[order[2]]
        second := tallies(&election, finalists)
        tie = second.first[first_candidate] == second.first[second_candidate]
        if second.first[second_candidate] > second.first[first_candidate]
            order[0], order[1] = order[1], order[0]
        rows = rows.append("finalists: " + name_list(election, finalists) + tie_text(advance))
        rows = rows.append("round 2: " + value_list(election, finalists, second.first))
    return finish(election, order, tie, rows)

Outcome bucklin(Election &election, const int[] field)
    scores := tallies(&election, field)
    line := scores.nonblank / 2 + 1
    rows := ["majority: {line}"]
    order := effective(election.tiebreak, field)
    int[] final := []
    for depth := field.indices()[]
        final = scores.approval[depth]
        order = stable_order(order, final, true)
        rows = rows.append("round {depth + 1}: " + value_list(election, field, final))
        if selected(final, field).max() >= line
            break
    return finish(election, order, final[order[0]] == final[order[1]], rows)

Outcome borda_elimination(Election &election, const int[] field, bool nanson)
    remaining := field
    int[] tail := []
    int[][] history := []
    string[] rows := []
    while #remaining >= 2
        scores := tallies(&election, remaining).borda
        row := "round {#rows + 1}: " + value_list(election, remaining, scores)
        int[] removed
        if nanson
            total := selected(scores, remaining).sum()
            int[] below := []
            for candidate := remaining[]
                if scores[candidate] * int(#remaining) < total
                    below = below.append(candidate)
            if #below == 0
                rows = rows.append(row)
                break
            row = row + "; eliminated " + name_list(election, below)
            removed = ordered(election, below, scores, true)
        else
            history = history.append(scores)
            choice := look_back(election, remaining, history)
            removed = [choice.candidate]
            row = row + "; eliminated " + election.names[choice.candidate] + tie_text(choice.tie)
        rows = rows.append(row)
        remaining = without(remaining, removed)
        tail = removed.concat(tail)
    int[] order := effective(election.tiebreak, remaining).concat(tail)
    return finish(election, order, nanson and #remaining > 1, rows)

string[] pair_lines(const Election election, const int[] field, const int[][] matrix)
    string[] rows := []
    for index := field.indices()[]
        first := field[index]
        for second := field[int(index) + 1:][]
            forward := matrix[first][second]
            backward := matrix[second][first]
            result := if forward == backward then "tie" elif forward > backward then election.names[first] else election.names[second]
            rows = rows.append(election.names[first] + " vs " + election.names[second] + ": {forward}-{backward} ({result})")
    return rows

bool[][] closure(const int[] field, bool[][] relation)
    for via := field[]
        for first := field[]
            for second := field[]
                relation[first][second] = relation[first][second] or (relation[first][via] and relation[via][second])
    return relation

Outcome condorcet_report(Election &election, const int[] field)
    win := condorcet(&election, field, false)
    lose := condorcet(&election, field, true)
    matrix := pairwise(&election)
    bool[][] weak := array(#election.names, fill = array(#election.names, fill = false))
    strong := weak
    for first := field[]
        for second := field[]
            weak[first][second] = matrix[first][second] >= matrix[second][first]
            strong[first][second] = matrix[first][second] > matrix[second][first]
    weak = closure(field, weak)
    strong = closure(field, strong)
    int[] smith := []
    int[] schwartz := []
    for candidate := field[]
        top := true
        unbeaten := true
        for other := field[]
            top = top and weak[candidate][other]
            unbeaten = unbeaten and (not strong[other][candidate] or strong[candidate][other])
        if top
            smith = smith.append(candidate)
        if unbeaten
            schwartz = schwartz.append(candidate)
    winner := if win < 0 then "NONE" else election.names[win]
    loser := if lose < 0 then "NONE" else election.names[lose]
    return Outcome([], ["winner: " + winner, "loser: " + loser, "smith: " + name_list(election, smith), "schwartz: " + name_list(election, schwartz)])

(int[], bool) topological(const Election election, const int[] field, const bool[][] relation)
    remaining := field
    int[] order := []
    tie := false
    while #remaining != 0
        int[] choices := []
        for candidate := remaining[]
            incoming := false
            for other := without(remaining, [candidate])[]
                incoming = incoming or relation[other][candidate]
            if not incoming
                choices = choices.append(candidate)
        if #order == 0
            tie = #choices > 1
        chosen := effective(election.tiebreak, choices)[0]
        order = order.append(chosen)
        remaining = without(remaining, [chosen])
    return (order, tie)

Outcome schulze(Election &election, const int[] field)
    matrix := pairwise(&election)
    int[][] paths := array(#election.names, fill = array(#election.names, fill = 0))
    for first := field[]
        for second := field[]
            if matrix[first][second] > matrix[second][first]
                paths[first][second] = matrix[first][second]
    for via := field[]
        for first := without(field, [via])[]
            for second := without(field, [via, first])[]
                paths[first][second] = math.max(paths[first][second], math.min(paths[first][via], paths[via][second]))
    bool[][] relation := array(#election.names, fill = array(#election.names, fill = false))
    for first := field[]
        for second := field[]
            relation[first][second] = paths[first][second] > paths[second][first]
    order, tie := topological(election, field, relation)
    rows := pair_lines(election, field, paths).append("ranking: " + name_list(election, order, " > "))
    return finish(election, order, tie, rows)

Outcome ranked_pairs(Election &election, const int[] field)
    matrix := pairwise(&election)
    Edge[] edges := []
    int[] wins := []
    int[] losses := []
    int[] sources := []
    int[] destinations := []
    for first := field[]
        for second := field[]
            if matrix[first][second] > matrix[second][first]
                edges = edges.append(Edge(first, second))
                wins = wins.append(matrix[first][second])
                losses = losses.append(matrix[second][first])
                sources = sources.append(election.priority[first])
                destinations = destinations.append(election.priority[second])
    order := stable_order(sequence(int(#edges)), destinations, false)
    order = stable_order(order, sources, false)
    order = stable_order(order, losses, false)
    order = stable_order(order, wins, true)
    bool[][] locked := array(#election.names, fill = array(#election.names, fill = false))
    reached := locked
    string[] rows := []
    for index := order[]
        edge := edges[index]
        accepted := not reached[edge.to][edge.from]
        label := if accepted then "lock" else "skip"
        rows = rows.append(label + " " + election.names[edge.from] + ">" + election.names[edge.to] + " " + string(matrix[edge.from][edge.to]) + "-" + string(matrix[edge.to][edge.from]))
        if accepted
            locked[edge.from][edge.to] = true
            reached[edge.from][edge.to] = true
            reached = closure(field, reached)
    standings, tie := topological(election, field, locked)
    return finish(election, standings, tie, rows)

Outcome kemeny(Election &election, const int[] field)
    matrix := pairwise(&election)
    limit := 2 ^ int(#election.names)
    best := array(nat(limit), fill = 0)
    ways := array(nat(limit), fill = 0)
    int[][] heads := array(nat(limit), fill = [])
    ways[0] = 1
    for: 1 <= subset < limit
        candidates := members(subset, int(#election.names))
        if #without(candidates, field) > 0
            continue
        best[subset] = -1
        for candidate := candidates[]
            rest := subset - 2 ^ candidate
            score := best[rest] + selected(matrix[candidate], without(candidates, [candidate])).sum()
            if score > best[subset]
                best[subset] = score
                ways[subset] = 0
                heads[subset] = []
            if score == best[subset]
                ways[subset] += ways[rest]
                heads[subset] = heads[subset].append(candidate)
    key := field_id(field)
    remaining := key
    int[] order := []
    while remaining > 0
        candidate := effective(election.tiebreak, heads[remaining])[0]
        order = order.append(candidate)
        remaining -= 2 ^ candidate
    rows := ["score: " + string(best[key]), "optimal: " + string(ways[key]), "ranking: " + name_list(election, order, " > ")]
    return finish(election, order, #heads[key] > 1, rows)

Outcome stv(Election &election, const int[] field, int seats)
    values := array(#election.groups, fill = 0)
    for index := election.groups.indices()[]
        if #effective(election.groups[index].ranking, field) > 0
            values[index] = 100
    quota := tallies(&election, field).nonblank * 100 / (seats + 1) + 1
    continuing := field
    int[] elected := []
    int[][] history := []
    rows := ["quota: " + money(quota)]
    while true
        scores := array(#election.names, fill = 0)
        owners := array(#election.groups, fill = -1)
        exhausted := 0
        for index := election.groups.indices()[]
            if values[index] == 0
                continue
            group := election.groups[index]
            ranking := effective(group.ranking, continuing)
            value := group.votes * values[index]
            if #ranking > 0
                owners[index] = ranking[0]
                scores[ranking[0]] += value
            else
                exhausted += value
        history = history.append(scores)
        row := "round {#history}: " + value_list(election, continuing, scores, true) + "; exhausted " + money(exhausted)
        order := ordered(election, continuing, scores, true)
        if int(#continuing) == seats - int(#elected)
            elected = elected.concat(order)
            rows = rows.append(row + "; elected " + name_list(election, order))
            break
        chosen := order[0]
        if scores[chosen] >= quota
            surplus := scores[chosen] - quota
            elected = elected.append(chosen)
            continuing = without(continuing, [chosen])
            for index := owners.indices()[]
                if owners[index] == chosen
                    values[index] = values[index] * surplus / scores[chosen]
            rows = rows.append(row + "; elected " + election.names[chosen] + " (surplus " + money(surplus) + ")")
            if int(#elected) == seats
                break
        else
            choice := look_back(election, continuing, history)
            continuing = without(continuing, [choice.candidate])
            rows = rows.append(row + "; excluded " + election.names[choice.candidate] + tie_text(choice.tie))
    return Outcome([], rows.append("elected: " + name_list(election, elected)))

string[] method_names()
    return ["PLURALITY", "RUNOFF", "IRV", "COOMBS", "BUCKLIN", "BORDA", "BALDWIN", "NANSON", "BLACK", "VETO", "CONDORCET", "COPELAND", "MINIMAX", "SCHULZE", "RANKEDPAIRS", "KEMENY", "APPROVAL", "STV"]

MethodKind[] method_kinds()
    return [MethodKind.Plurality, MethodKind.Runoff, MethodKind.Irv, MethodKind.Coombs, MethodKind.Bucklin, MethodKind.Borda, MethodKind.Baldwin, MethodKind.Nanson, MethodKind.Black, MethodKind.Veto, MethodKind.Condorcet, MethodKind.Copeland, MethodKind.Minimax, MethodKind.Schulze, MethodKind.RankedPairs, MethodKind.Kemeny, MethodKind.Approval, MethodKind.Stv]

Method parse_method(const string[] words)
    kind := method_kinds()[position_of(method_names(), words[0])]
    method := Method(kind)
    if kind == MethodKind.Approval or kind == MethodKind.Stv
        method.parameter = int(words[1])
    elif kind == MethodKind.Minimax
        method.score = if words[1] == "WINNING" then MinimaxKind.Winning elif words[1] == "MARGIN" then MinimaxKind.Margin else MinimaxKind.Opposition
    return method

string method_text(const Method method)
    name := method_names()[position_of(method_kinds(), method.kind)]
    if method.kind == MethodKind.Minimax
        kind := if method.score == MinimaxKind.Winning then "WINNING" elif method.score == MinimaxKind.Margin then "MARGIN" else "OPPOSITION"
        return name + " " + kind
    if method.kind == MethodKind.Approval or method.kind == MethodKind.Stv
        return name + " " + string(method.parameter)
    return name

Method[] summary_methods()
    return [Method(MethodKind.Plurality), Method(MethodKind.Runoff), Method(MethodKind.Irv), Method(MethodKind.Coombs), Method(MethodKind.Bucklin), Method(MethodKind.Borda), Method(MethodKind.Baldwin), Method(MethodKind.Nanson), Method(MethodKind.Black), Method(MethodKind.Veto), Method(MethodKind.Copeland), Method(MethodKind.Minimax), Method(MethodKind.Schulze), Method(MethodKind.RankedPairs), Method(MethodKind.Kemeny)]

Outcome tally(Election &election, const int[] field, const Method method)
    kind := method.kind
    if kind == MethodKind.Runoff
        return runoff(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Irv or kind == MethodKind.Coombs
        return elimination(&election, field, kind == MethodKind.Coombs)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Bucklin
        return bucklin(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Baldwin or kind == MethodKind.Nanson
        return borda_elimination(&election, field, kind == MethodKind.Nanson)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Condorcet
        return condorcet_report(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Schulze
        return schulze(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.RankedPairs
        return ranked_pairs(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Kemeny
        return kemeny(&election, field)
    elif kind == MethodKind.Stv
        return stv(&election, field, method.parameter)
    base := tallies(&election, field)
    scores := array(#election.names, fill = 0)
    label := "scores"
    descending := true
    string[] rows := []
    winner := -1
    if kind == MethodKind.Plurality
        scores = base.first
        label = "votes"
    elif kind == MethodKind.Borda or kind == MethodKind.Black
        scores = base.borda
        if kind == MethodKind.Black
            winner = condorcet(&election, field, false)
            rows = rows.append("condorcet: " + (if winner < 0 then "NONE" else election.names[winner]))
    elif kind == MethodKind.Veto
        scores = base.last
        label = "vetoes"
        descending = false
    elif kind == MethodKind.Approval
        scores = base.approval[math.min(method.parameter, int(#field)) - 1]
        label = "approvals"
    elif kind == MethodKind.Copeland
        matrix := pairwise(&election)
        string[] parts := []
        for candidate := field[]
            wins := 0
            draws := 0
            losses := 0
            for other := without(field, [candidate])[]
                if matrix[candidate][other] > matrix[other][candidate]
                    wins += 1
                elif matrix[candidate][other] == matrix[other][candidate]
                    draws += 1
                else
                    losses += 1
            scores[candidate] = 2 * wins + draws
            score := scores[candidate]
            parts = parts.append(election.names[candidate] + " {score / 2}.{score % 2 * 5} ({wins}-{draws}-{losses})")
        rows = rows.append("scores: " + parts.join(", "))
    elif kind == MethodKind.Minimax
        matrix := pairwise(&election)
        descending = false
        for candidate := field[]
            int[] possibilities := []
            for other := without(field, [candidate])[]
                opposition := matrix[other][candidate]
                support := matrix[candidate][other]
                value := 0
                if method.score == MinimaxKind.Opposition
                    value = opposition
                elif opposition > support
                    value = if method.score == MinimaxKind.Margin then opposition - support else opposition
                possibilities = possibilities.append(value)
            scores[candidate] = possibilities.max()
    order := ordered(election, field, scores, descending)
    tie := scores[order[0]] == scores[order[1]]
    if winner >= 0
        order = [winner].concat(without(order, [winner]))
        tie = false
    if kind != MethodKind.Copeland
        rows = rows.append(label + ": " + value_list(election, field, scores))
    return finish(election, order, tie, rows)

int count_or_zero(const map<string, int> counts, string key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int count
            return count
        none
            return 0

string[] ballots_report(const Election election)
    map<string, int> counts
    field := active_field(election)
    blank := 0
    for group := election.groups[]
        ranking := effective(group.ranking, field)
        notation := if #ranking == 0 then "-" else name_list(election, ranking, ">")
        if #ranking == 0
            blank += group.votes
        .counts.set(notation, count_or_zero(counts, notation) + group.votes)
    notations := counts.keys().sorted()
    int[] votes := []
    for notation := notations[]
        votes = votes.append(count_or_zero(counts, notation))
    order := stable_order(sequence(int(#notations)), votes, true)
    rows := ["total {election.total}, blank {blank}, distinct {#notations}"]
    for index := order[]
        rows = rows.append(string(votes[index]) + " " + notations[index])
    return rows

string[] status(const Election election)
    int[] withdrawn := []
    for candidate := election.names.indices()[]
        if not election.active[candidate]
            withdrawn = withdrawn.append(int(candidate))
    missing := if #withdrawn == 0 then "none" else name_list(election, withdrawn)
    return ["election {election.number}", "active: " + name_list(election, active_field(election)), "withdrawn: " + missing, "tiebreak: " + name_list(election, election.tiebreak), "ballots: {election.total} in {#election.ends} entries"]

string[] | error execute_election(Election &election, const string[] words, string line)
    command := words[0]
    if command == "BALLOT"
        int[] ranking := []
        if words[2] != "-"
            ranking = try checked_names(election, words[2].split(">"))
        votes := int(words[1])
        election.groups = election.groups.append(Ballot(votes, ranking))
        election.total += votes
        election.ends = election.ends.append(int(#election.groups))
        invalidate(&election)
        return []
    elif command == "RANDOM"
        count := int(words[1])
        state := int(words[2])
        for: 0 <= group < count
            ranking := active_field(election)
            for: int(#ranking) - 1 >= place >= 1
                state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
                other := state % (place + 1)
                ranking[place], ranking[other] = ranking[other], ranking[place]
            state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
            length := state % int(#ranking) + 1
            election.groups = election.groups.append(Ballot(1, ranking[:<length]))
        election.total += count
        election.ends = election.ends.append(int(#election.groups))
        invalidate(&election)
        return []
    elif command == "UNDO"
        if #election.ends == 0
            return error("nothing to undo")
        election.ends = election.ends[:<int(#election.ends) - 1]
        end := if #election.ends == 0 then 0 else election.ends[-1]
        int[] removed := []
        for group := election.groups[end:][]
            removed = removed.append(group.votes)
        election.total -= removed.sum()
        election.groups = election.groups[:<end]
        invalidate(&election)
        return []
    elif command == "WITHDRAW" or command == "RESTORE"
        candidate := try candidate_index(election, words[1])
        if command == "WITHDRAW"
            if not election.active[candidate]
                return error("already withdrawn " + words[1])
            if #active_field(election) <= 2
                return error("too few candidates")
            election.active[candidate] = false
        else
            if election.active[candidate]
                return error("not withdrawn " + words[1])
            election.active[candidate] = true
        return []
    elif command == "TIEBREAK"
        order := try checked_names(election, words[1:])
        if #order != #election.names
            return error("incomplete tiebreak")
        election.tiebreak = order
        for place := order.indices()[]
            election.priority[order[place]] = int(place)
        return []
    rows := ["[" + line + "]"]
    if command == "STATUS"
        return rows.concat(status(election))
    if #election.ends == 0
        return error("no ballots")
    field := active_field(election)
    if command == "RANKING" or command == "SPOILERS"
        method := parse_method(words[1:])
        if method.kind == MethodKind.Condorcet or method.kind == MethodKind.Stv
            return error("not rankable")
        if command == "SPOILERS" and #field < 3
            return error("too few candidates")
        result := tally(&election, field, method)
        if command == "RANKING"
            return rows.append(name_list(election, result.order, " > "))
        winner := result.order[0]
        rows = rows.append("winner: " + election.names[winner])
        for candidate := without(field, [winner])[]
            other := tally(&election, without(field, [candidate]), method).order[0]
            suffix := if other == winner then "" else " (changed)"
            rows = rows.append("without " + election.names[candidate] + ": " + election.names[other] + suffix)
        return rows
    int[] compared := []
    if command == "COMPARE"
        for name := words[1:][]
            candidate := try candidate_index(election, name)
            if not election.active[candidate]
                return error("withdrawn candidate " + name)
            compared = compared.append(candidate)
        if compared[0] == compared[1]
            return error("same candidate")
    if command == "STV" and int(words[1]) >= int(#field)
        return error("too many seats")
    if command == "BALLOTS"
        return rows.concat(ballots_report(election))
    elif command == "PROFILE"
        scores := tallies(&election, field)
        for candidate := field[]
            string[] counts := []
            previous := 0
            for depth := field.indices()[]
                cumulative := scores.approval[depth][candidate]
                counts = counts.append(string(cumulative - previous))
                previous = cumulative
            rows = rows.append(election.names[candidate] + ": " + counts.join(" ") + " unranked {election.total - previous}")
        return rows
    elif command == "PAIRWISE"
        matrix := pairwise(&election)
        return rows.concat(pair_lines(election, field, matrix))
    elif command == "EXHAUSTED"
        return rows.concat(elimination(&election, field, false, true).rows)
    elif command == "SUMMARY" or command == "COMPARE"
        wins := array(#election.names, fill = 0)
        string[][] ahead := [[], []]
        for method := summary_methods()[]
            result := tally(&election, field, method)
            label := method_text(method)
            if command == "SUMMARY"
                winner := result.order[0]
                wins[winner] += 1
                rows = rows.append(label + ": " + election.names[winner])
            else
                side := if position_of(result.order, compared[0]) < position_of(result.order, compared[1]) then 0 else 1
                ahead[side] = ahead[side].append(label)
        if command == "SUMMARY"
            return rows.append("wins: " + value_list(election, field, wins))
        matrix := pairwise(&election)
        first := compared[0]
        second := compared[1]
        forward := matrix[first][second]
        backward := matrix[second][first]
        rows = rows.append(election.names[first] + " {forward}, " + election.names[second] + " {backward}, neither {election.total - forward - backward}")
        for: 0 <= side < 2
            text := if #ahead[side] == 0 then "none" else ahead[side].join(", ")
            rows = rows.append(election.names[compared[side]] + " ahead: " + text)
        return rows
    return rows.concat(tally(&election, field, parse_method(words)).rows)

string[] | error execute(Laboratory &lab, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    if words[0] == "CANDIDATES"
        names := words[1:]
        if #names == 1
            return error("too few candidates")
        string[] seen := []
        for name := names[]
            if position_of(seen, name) >= 0
                return error("duplicate candidate " + name)
            seen = seen.append(name)
        election := Election(lab.number + 1, names)
        for name := names.sorted()[]
            election.tiebreak = election.tiebreak.append(position_of(names, name))
        for place := election.tiebreak.indices()[]
            election.priority[election.tiebreak[place]] = int(place)
        lab.number += 1
        lab.current = election
        return ["election {lab.number}: {#names} candidates"]
    match lab.current
        Election election
            rows := try execute_election(&election, words, line)
            lab.current = election
            return rows
        none
            return error("no election")

election_lab := Laboratory()
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: 0 <= command_index < command_count
    string command_line
    scan(&command_line)
    match execute(&election_lab, command_line)
        string[] rows
            for row := rows[]
                println(row)
        error problem
            println("ERROR " + problem.message)
